"""Record yfinance fixtures for the slice 6 step 3 client tests. Measurement script, not repo code
(named .txt so no linter picks it up). Run in the pinned base image with the runtime lock installed:

    python record.py.txt <out_dir> [name,name]     (default: every fixture)

Each fixture is one `yfinance.multi._download_impl` call exactly as the client makes it (group_by
ticker, auto_adjust=False, prepost=False, threads, progress off), with our own `_DownloadCtx` so the
per-ticker errors yfinance swallows are kept beside the frame. The frame is serialised losslessly:
floats by repr (JSON round-trips them exactly), NaN as null, the index as ISO strings with its
timezone recorded (daily batches are timezone-naive, F-c; intraday are timezone-aware).
"""

import json
import math
import sys
from datetime import UTC, datetime

import yfinance as yf
from yfinance.multi import _download_impl, _DownloadCtx

# The 24 seeded symbols, exactly settings.UNIVERSES (rotation 14 + SPY + QQQ, RSP + 7 commodity proxies).
# Corrected 2026-11-18: the first recording used a list typed from memory (XLC and IBB instead of IWM
# and ARKK); daily_3mo_universe_plus_dead was re-recorded with this one.
UNIVERSE = [
    "XLK", "SMH", "IGV", "XLF", "XLE", "XLI", "XLV", "XLY", "XLP", "XLU", "XLB", "XLRE", "IWM", "ARKK",
    "SPY", "QQQ", "RSP", "USO", "UNG", "GLD", "SLV", "CPER", "URA", "DBA",
]
DEAD = "ZZZQXFAKE"

CALLS = {
    # Daily, 3 months, the whole universe plus a dead ticker; actions on (Capital Gains, Stock Splits).
    "daily_3mo_universe_plus_dead": dict(tickers=UNIVERSE + [DEAD], period="3mo", interval="1d", actions=True),
    # The five 2:1 splits of 2025-12-05 (step 1(b)), with the sessions either side.
    "daily_split_2025_12_05": dict(
        tickers=["XLK", "XLE", "XLY", "XLU", "XLB"], start="2025-11-26", end="2025-12-13", interval="1d", actions=True
    ),
    # NVDA 10:1 effective 2024-06-10: the D3 reference value (2024-06-07 rebuilds to about 1,208.88).
    "daily_split_nvda_2024_06_10": dict(tickers=["NVDA", "SPY"], start="2024-06-03", end="2024-06-15", interval="1d", actions=True),
    # 15-minute bars, 5 days, three symbols plus the dead one; actions off (the client's intraday call).
    "m15_5d_three_plus_dead": dict(tickers=["SPY", "QQQ", "XLK", DEAD], period="5d", interval="15m", actions=False),
}


def record(name: str, call: dict) -> dict:
    ctx = _DownloadCtx()
    started = datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()
    df = _download_impl(
        ctx, call["tickers"], start=call.get("start"), end=call.get("end"), period=call.get("period"),
        interval=call["interval"], actions=call["actions"], auto_adjust=False, prepost=False,
        group_by="ticker", threads=True, progress=False,
    )
    tz = str(df.index.tz) if getattr(df.index, "tz", None) is not None else None

    def cell(v):
        return None if v is None or (isinstance(v, float) and math.isnan(v)) else float(v)

    return {
        "meta": {"name": name, "yfinance": yf.__version__, "fetched_at": started, "call": call},
        "errors": dict(ctx.errors),
        "index_tz": tz,
        "index": [ts.isoformat() for ts in df.index],
        "columns": [list(c) for c in df.columns],
        "data": [[cell(v) for v in row] for row in df.itertuples(index=False, name=None)],
    }


only = set(sys.argv[2].split(",")) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else set(CALLS)
for name, call in CALLS.items():
    if name not in only:
        continue
    out = record(name, call)
    path = f"{sys.argv[1]}/{name}.json"
    with open(path, "w") as f:
        json.dump(out, f, separators=(",", ":"))
    print(path, len(out["index"]), "rows", len(out["columns"]), "columns", "tz", out["index_tz"], "errors", out["errors"])
